scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: An ordered seed-to-mask mapping containing each seed position, seed color, selected prototype color, and occupied prototype offsets.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read each seed color below the divider and select the occupied 3x3 header-prototype mask dictated by prototype_policy; opposite_shape selects the other color prototype.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Rebuild the workspace below the divider and stamp each selected offset mask at its seed position while painting with the seed color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The set of cells written by each stamp is exactly the mask selected in step A; substituting the matching-color mask for the opposite-color mask changes the final footprint.
